legacy_findings_preserved.title: m9-66 apply-checkpoint.json line 35 had invalid JSON escape (raw \| on the wire)
evidence: Original line 35 had a raw '\|' (bytes 0x5C 0x7C) which is not a valid JSON escape.
Promoted to '\\|' (bytes 0x5C 0x5C 0x7C) — valid escape representing the regex characters '^\|'.
json.load() now succeeds on m9-66 apply-checkpoint.
